name: Ryakudatsu Mesu Breeder ~Ubawareta Koibito Kuruwasareta Hitozuma~
original_name: 略奪牝ブリーダー ～奪われた恋人 狂わされた人妻～
source:
Stealing and training elite, upper-class beauties during their school days—
Then, as they grow into women and establish their social status,
using the groundwork laid during their youth to dominate them further—
This is the twisted legacy of Kiryuuin Reiga, the heir to a family of deviants.

Reiga attends Kougakuen Academy, an elite institution for the children of the country’s wealthiest and most powerful families.
Unwavering in his commitment to his family’s depraved traditions,
he sets his sights on Hakuhouin Hikaru—the fiancée of his best friend, Ayanokouji Kousuke…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008061.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
偷调学生时代的精英、上层美女——
然后，当她们成长为女性并确立自己的社会地位时，
利用他们年轻时打下的基础来进一步支配他们——
这是异端家族继承人桐生院礼伽的扭曲遗产。

礼贺就读于高学园学院，这是一所为日本最富有、最有权势的家庭的孩子们开设的精英学府。
坚定不移地致力于家族的堕落传统，
他把目光投向了白凤院光——他最好的朋友绫小路康介的未婚妻……
